architecture_binding.target_scope: deterministic recipient-scoped OFFERED/DELIVERED/UPTAKEN evidence plus matched intervention/control causal falsification

source_surfaces.observed_mechanism: Inspect is an extensible Python LLM-evaluation framework with tasks, tools, multi-turn/model-graded evaluation support, reproducible development locking and repository test commands.

The eval API exposes explicit task/model/solver selection, metadata, sample_id, sample_shuffle including integer seeding, epochs, retry/error handling, message/token/turn/time/cost limits, concurrency limits and structured log controls, returning EvalLog objects.
EvalConfig and sample summaries preserve explicit sample identity, epoch, input, target, metadata, limits, retries and log controls rather than reducing evaluation to an aggregate score.

Each evaluation produces per-task logs and programmatic EvalLog records containing run status, eval specification, plan, results, stats, errors, metadata/provenance edits and per-sample input/output/target/score; the documented API requires checking run status before interpreting results.

Human intervention is explicitly recorded in transcripts through operator messages and interruption/limit events; remote ACP exposure is documented as unauthenticated unless protected by the surrounding transport. This is useful provenance discipline but outside the minimal WP507 causal-pair core.

The full framework has a broad dependency surface including agent protocol, cloud/storage, web server, numerical, UI, tokenization and compression packages, materially heavier than the narrow deterministic WP507 component.

strongest_transfer: MATCHED_PAIR_RUN_SHAPE: represent control and intervention as explicit, independently addressable samples/tasks with shared experiment metadata rather than a narrative comparison.

EXPLICIT_SAMPLE_SELECTION_AND_SEEDED_ORDER: deterministic sample_id and integer-seeded shuffle surfaces can inform replayable paired-run scheduling when the seed/order is itself bound into F2 evidence.
STRUCTURED_OUTCOME_LOGGING: preserve per-run status, error, input/output and metadata so a failed or partial control cannot be silently scored as causal evidence.
SCORER_SCANNER_AS_SECONDARY_CHECK: use deterministic F2-native scorers/checkers around exact receipt contracts while keeping the canonical receipt and EffectGate/UnifiedDB authority outside Inspect.
nontransferable_authority: EvalLog is an evaluation artifact, not canonical Frankenstein state or causal truth.
Aggregate scorer metrics cannot mint semantic-uptake or causal-influence credit.
Inspect model/tool/sandbox adapters must not create a second provider/effect execution path for WP507.
Human intervention and generic agent control are out of scope for a matched causal pair unless explicitly modeled as part of the intervention.

dependency_and_license_assessment.license: MIT is permissive for source-pattern study and lawful reuse subject to notice requirements.
dependency_and_license_assessment.reason: The framework intentionally spans model providers, agents, sandboxes, UI/control, cloud log storage and broad evaluation facilities; WP507 currently needs a small exact-identity matched-pair falsifier, not a second evaluation platform.

counterhypotheses: Current F2 repository tests may already encode all matched intervention/control semantics needed by WP507, making Inspect-derived structure redundant.
Generic EvalLog metadata and post-eval edit facilities are weaker provenance than an immutable F2-native causal receipt and could be misread as authority if directly adopted.
Retries, random sample order and model/tool abstraction can introduce confounds unless disabled or explicitly seeded and bound into the matched-pair identity.
A full Inspect dependency could increase startup, dependency, security and maintenance surface without improving falsifier coverage or causal certainty.

adjudication.next_discriminator: Only under a separately acquired E2_ARCHITECTURE_MAPPED claim, map the minimal Task/Sample/eval/EvalLog/scorer-scanner state machine onto the exact WP507 G3 broadcast/probe/recipient/digest ABI and count genuinely new fail-closed coverage. Reject the donor if it adds no new discriminator beyond current F2 tests.
